source.quote: Looking ahead, we expect TELUS International EBITDA margins to trend on the higher end of the 20% to 25% range, and we anticipate another year of double-digit year-over-year organic EBITDA growth for 2020.
We were also able to maintain strong EBITDA margins at the high end of our targeted range, while delivering strong simple cash flow underpinned by TI's mid-single-digit capex intensity profile.

Second, we are deploying a disciplined approach to investments, focusing on strengthening core telecom and digital infrastructure with 2026 CapEx expected to be approximately $2.6 billion, up from approximately $2.3 billion previously communicated.
This compares to our prior forecast for both consolidated service revenue and adjusted EBITDA to be 2% to 4% growth year-over-year.

Despite the in-year CapEx increase, which I outlined earlier, we remain committed to our multiyear approach of reducing capital intensity as a percentage of total revenue, as we continue to drive towards our target of 10%.
